name: create_task
description: Create a background task and immediately return its ID. Include goal, context, constraints and deliverables in text. Interpret the applicable AGENTS.md routing rules semantically using available configured Providers and models. Explicit current-task choices take precedence; otherwise leave unmatched work on existing defaults. Never silently substitute an unavailable preferred executor. Each task is a new execution. To retry finished work, create a new task. Tasks run in a separate workspace on the fixed selected Runtime. Omitted machine_id uses the owning Control. Files are not copied from other workspaces. Tool calls require current machine authorization; completion closes only this Task's processes and sessions while retaining files. The text must contain a concise title on its first line AND complete instructions on following lines. A title-only brief is rejected. Preserve the user's exact commands and constraints; workers do not see the chat.

profile.description: Configured Provider connection Profile ID chosen autonomously for this task. Omit to use the invoking assistant’s active configuration. No user allowlist or route confirmation is needed.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

selection_reason.description: Concise creation-time reason for the chosen executor; do not claim certainty for ambiguous work.

skills.description: Global skill names to include in this task. Omitted or empty loads no global skills. Project skills are always discovered independently.

machine_id.description: Target enrolled Runtime ID. Omitted uses the owning Control. The destination is fixed for this run and never automatically replaced.

model.description: Concrete model ID supported by the selected Provider. Omitted uses that Provider’s default model; with no Provider selection, uses the invoking assistant’s active model.

name: list_tasks
description: Search task metadata by state and title/ID. Defaults to active tasks, 10 per page; archived tasks keep complete/cancelled status. Use attention for failed/interrupted, archived to find past results, all only with a relevant query. Follow next_offset only when needed; no polling.

phase.description: Exact execution status; overrides scope when provided

q.description: Case-insensitive title or task ID substring

name: get_task
description: Read recent results and execution state of a task.

name: send_message
description: Send a durable message to a Task or assistant using its address and the message text. Runtime binds the real sender, message provenance and reply linkage automatically. Active Tasks receive owner guidance or peer reference at a model boundary; ended Tasks retain reference without restarting. Returns acceptance, never execution completion. Do not send task completion yourself: Runtime reports final results automatically.

name: interrupt
description: Interrupt current work while retaining task/session/files and pending guidance. Does not replay interrupted input or automatically resume. Running work retains capacity until cleanup is confirmed; run again by creating a new task. Completed task results remain complete.

name: cancel_task
description: Abandon a task: stop current execution, discard pending guidance and mark cancelled after confirmed cleanup. Retains history and files; cancelled tasks appear in Archived. Use interrupt to preserve guidance for later continuation. Completed results remain complete.

name: list_schedules
description: List scheduled plans (metadata only). Filter enabled/paused/all; use pagination.

name: get_schedule
description: Read a schedule definition and paginated execution history.

name: manage_schedule
description: Create/update/pause/resume/delete/run a persistent schedule. Pausing/deleting prevents future triggers and does not cancel current work. An immediate run is non-overlapping. All times use the specified IANA timezone. Control triggers a new task on the saved machine; each dispatch reads that machine's current execution policy. Omit machine_id on update to preserve the selected machine. Creation/update requires spec. Deletion is soft and keeps execution history.

profile.description: Configured Provider Profile ID chosen autonomously. Omit to snapshot the owning assistant’s configuration at each trigger.

desktop.description: Native desktop automation is currently unsupported. Independent headless browser automation does not require desktop=true.

machine_id.description: Machine to run on. Each occurrence reads its current execution policy and creates a fresh Task. Omit on update to retain the machine.

model.description: Concrete model supported by the selected configured Provider.

name: list_execution_targets
description: Inspect registered Runtime destinations and their machine policies. Discovery grants no execution authority.

name: list_assistants
description: List addressable assistants in this Control and Spaces connected through the App relay. A listed remote assistant may be offline. Does not start work.

name: get_model_catalog
description: Discover configured Provider profiles with offset/limit, or supply profile for its model facts. models and configured_models are separately paginated with the same offset/limit and report their totals.
